title: Altered private reference
path: A valid user/collaborator supplies another private resource identifier through UI/file/provider/Git entry.
boundary: Current exact resource/action authority is not implied by sign-in, guessed identifier or unrelated membership.
planned_case: Allowed/denied direct/list/search cases for reviewed scopes without disclosing protected content.
status: Source-derived boundary/failure scenario; not a confirmed vulnerability or executed security test

title: Changed link/password/grant
path: A fresh or already-open request outlives a relevant confirmed rights change.
boundary: Fresh disabled-link denial is required; existing/in-flight/cached delivery requires its separately reviewed policy; no recall of delivered bytes.
planned_case: Controlled fresh/current-session/in-flight cases with actual effective change and explicit applicable policy.
status: Source-derived boundary/failure scenario; not a confirmed vulnerability or executed security test

title: Untrusted content crossing display/processing
path: Authorized upload/embed or provider content is malformed/unsupported or interpreted outside permitted content meaning.
boundary: Authority to supply data is not proof of trusted/safe content or permission to execute code.
planned_case: Reviewed valid/invalid/unsafe content and safe serving/display cases; no live hostile test here.
status: Source-derived boundary/failure scenario; not a confirmed vulnerability or executed security test

title: Workflow input reaching host/secret/target
path: Repository/workflow content requests resources, credentials, network or deployment powers beyond reviewed contract.
boundary: Actual suitable isolation/permission/resource/secret/target evidence required before enablement; no arbitrary host authority.
planned_case: Later explicitly authorized isolated negative/positive execution cases only after enabling gates.
requirement_ids: QSR-D07; YML-D04; YML-D05; YML-D06; YML-D10; YML-D12
status: Source-derived boundary/failure scenario; not a confirmed vulnerability or executed security test

title: Wrong/revoked provider account
path: A product login or retained connection record is treated as actual permission for another account/operation.
boundary: Selected current account and operation capability are independent of product grants; retained copies not necessarily fresh.
planned_case: Intended/wrong-account/revoked/denied capability cases when actual controlled access exists.
status: Source-derived boundary/failure scenario; not a confirmed vulnerability or executed security test

title: Ambiguous send and duplicate action
path: Response lost or final content changed but old confirmation/automatic retry is reused.
boundary: Exact final review and same-attempt reconciliation; acceptance not delivery/read and no blind resend.
planned_case: Changed final attachment and ambiguous acceptance cases using controlled future recipients after access setup.
status: Source-derived boundary/failure scenario; not a confirmed vulnerability or executed security test

title: Reference/usage race during replacement
path: New admissions or cleanup rely on stale capacity/reference state and harm protected retained history.
boundary: Current effective policy/actual reference contract; eligibility/admission not usable completion or freed bytes.
planned_case: Concurrent growth, failed replacement, protected reference and partial cleanup cases under defined accounting.
requirement_ids: QSR-D02; QSR-D08; QSR-D09; AFO-D04; AFO-D07; AFO-D11
status: Source-derived boundary/failure scenario; not a confirmed vulnerability or executed security test

title: Stale Git integration context
path: Source/target changes after review/check or prior ref effect is unknown.
boundary: Exact current evaluated revisions/authority and actual ref result govern integration, not moving names or stale approval.
planned_case: Changed-source/target/protected-ref/conflict/unknown integration cases in later supported isolated real-client environment.
status: Source-derived boundary/failure scenario; not a confirmed vulnerability or executed security test

title: Sensitive result/diagnostic disclosure
path: Run logs/artifacts, provider errors or ordinary diagnostics expose credentials/private content or allow unrelated read.
boundary: Explicit bounded output/evidence access and secret-safe representation; ownership of another context is insufficient.
planned_case: Synthetic sensitive markers and unauthorized output/reference cases; no real secret values printed.
status: Source-derived boundary/failure scenario; not a confirmed vulnerability or executed security test

title: Old access/external effects after restore
path: Restored grants/mappings/pending actions differ from current rights/provider/ref/target state.
boundary: Current access and external disposition need explicit reconciliation; no old-right activation or blind replay.
planned_case: Later isolated old-grant/revocation/pending-send/job/deleted-data examples with defined expected dispositions.
status: Source-derived boundary/failure scenario; not a confirmed vulnerability or executed security test

title: False health/audit confidence
path: A successful page, incomplete evidence or procedure output is treated as all-service health/security/recovery proof.
boundary: Actual bounded evidence with environment/coverage/result/limits; no immutable audit or generic security certification.
planned_case: Selected event/evidence-access and missing/partial-result cases; compare exact scoped success definition.
status: Source-derived boundary/failure scenario; not a confirmed vulnerability or executed security test

title: Competing workload saturation
path: Uploads/media/Git/conditional processing compete with baseline services or recovery/maintenance work.
boundary: Actual mixed-workload/resource/limit/degradation contract required; no extrapolation from idle usage or user count.
planned_case: Later bounded mixed workload and saturation cases after exact environment/limits/stop conditions are authorized.
status: Source-derived boundary/failure scenario; not a confirmed vulnerability or executed security test
